note: Verified against the live shadcn registry index (ui.shadcn.com/r/registries.json) and each registry's own registry.json on 2026-10-01. Namespace commands are installed with `npx shadcn@latest add @ns/item`.

sections.name: Asymmetric editorial hero

sources.note: per-character/word reveal, no library lock-in
only if the brief is genuinely product-visual

build: 12-col grid; type block occupies cols 1-7, product surface cols 8-12 at >=1024px, stacked below
display type clamp(2.75rem,5vw,4.5rem)/0.98/-0.03em from DESIGN.md; body 65ch max
one dominant element per viewport: the headline, not a card
NO centred hero - the message is not the whole design (CRITIQUE hard fail 4)
LCP element is text painted by CSS, never a JS-mounted canvas/3D scene
sections.content: Real product claim in the user's own words as the h1; a real sub-claim with a number or a concrete mechanism; 1 primary + 1 secondary CTA (1-3 words each, never wrapping); an honest trust line only if the user supplied one.
sections.motion: ONE orchestrated moment: the type reveal (staggerChildren 0.06, y 12->0, ease.out 320ms). Nothing else on the page animates on entry.
a11y: h1 is the single page h1; heading order h1->h2 only
contrast >=4.5:1 measured over the actual substrate incl. any gradient
reduced motion -> fades only, never opacity:0 without JS
hardFails: two CTAs with the same intent
avoidWhen: the product IS a visual/3D artefact - use hero-split-product or hero-kinetic-signature

sections.name: Split hero with real product surface

sources.note: real recording in a dialog; never a fake browser chrome

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add button tabs dialog

build: left: value proposition + CTA; right: the real UI (screenshot of the built app, or the live component)
screenshot must be a real capture of the product at 2x, with explicit width/height (no CLS)
dialog video: real recording only; fake browser/phone chrome is CRITIQUE hard fail 12
sticky-stack the media on scroll only if the page has >4 sections
sections.content: Headline names the mechanism, not the category ('Turn Postgres queries into shareable charts', not 'Unlock your data'); the media shows the actual output; bullet list is 3 concrete capabilities with artefacts.
sections.motion: Media does not animate in as a whole; if anything moves it is the reveal of the real surface (clip-path or mask, 320ms).
a11y: media has alt text describing what it shows
keyboard focus reaches the CTA before the media
explicit dimensions prevent CLS
avoidWhen: no real product surface exists yet - use hero-asymmetric-editorial

sections.name: Floating pill navbar

sources.note: shrinks on scroll - verify no CLS

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add navigation-menu sheet button

build: max one nav archetype per site (CRITIQUE Part 1b); a second page gets a different archetype
mobile: Sheet on <768px, never a squeezed desktop row
scroll behaviour changes elevation/border only - never height without a reserved slot
active-route state is a real token, not an underline drawn with a box-shadow hack
sections.content: Real route labels; the primary CTA repeats the hero's primary intent (same label); no 'Home/About/Services/Contact' filler unless those pages exist.
sections.motion: elevation/backdrop change on scroll (200ms inOut); menu opens <=180ms; no bounce.
a11y: 44px min tap targets on mobile
focus-visible ring on every item
aria-expanded on the trigger
skip-to-content link in the layout, not the nav
hardFails: h-screen mobile menu without scroll-lock + focus trap
avoidWhen: the site has <=2 pages - a nav is optional

sections.name: Classic sticky header

sources.note: check the licence on pro items

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add navigation-menu sheet button separator

build: sticky top, border-bottom only on scroll
container width matches the page container (DESIGN.md)
docs: nav + on-this-page TOC as a two-column shell
sections.content: Labels match the real IA; a search entry point appears when the product has search.
sections.motion: none beyond a 120ms border/background transition - headers should not perform.
a11y: focus order follows DOM order
contrast of the scrolled state over content
hardFails: sticky header that eats >15% of a 390px viewport height

sections.name: Logo wall / marquee

sources.note: pause-on-hover + reduced-motion aware

build: ONLY with real logos the user supplied - unnamed/invented logos are CRITIQUE hard fail 17
no logos available -> omit the section entirely or add an honest 'integrations' list of real specs
duplicate the logo row for the loop; aria-hidden the duplicate
grayscale + opacity tokens; full colour on hover at most
sections.content: Real names only. If the user has none, replace with a factual integrations row ('Works with Postgres, MySQL, SQLite') which is honest and still proves compatibility.
sections.motion: constant-speed marquee (not ease-in-out); pause on hover and focus; stop entirely under reduced motion.
a11y: the duplicate track is aria-hidden
no focusable elements inside a marquee
sufficient contrast for logo-on-substrate
avoidWhen: no real logos exist - use feature-comparison-table instead

sections.name: Attributed testimonial grid
build: max ONE testimonial layout family per page (Part 1b)
masonry is only justified when cells differ in length; otherwise a 2-col grid
real avatars with a real fallback (initials token), never a generic illustration
sections.content: Quote is specific and names an outcome; attribution carries name + role + company; a metric appears only if the user supplied it.
sections.motion: staggered reveal once per session; no re-trigger on scroll direction change.
a11y: blockquote semantics
the avatars have alt text or are decorative with aria-hidden
no carousel autoplay without a pause control
avoidWhen: no real quotes exist - omit the section

sections.name: Metric / stat band

sources.note: Emil Kowalski; best-in-class digits

build: the final value MUST be correct in the DOM for no-JS and screen readers
tabular-nums on every figure (Vercel guidelines)
max 4 stats; each carries a unit and a date/footnote
sections.content: Only user-supplied numbers. No number = no band. A number without a unit or a period is not a metric.
sections.motion: count up once on first viewport entry (700ms max); never loop.
a11y: the final value is the text content, not the animated intermediate
aria-live is NOT used for decorative counting
hardFails: counting animation that hides the value when JS fails
avoidWhen: the user supplied no numbers - use feature-comparison-table

sections.name: Bento feature grid
build: cell count EQUALS content count - never pad the grid to look full (Part 1b)
one dominant tile with real product visual; the rest text-only
12-col grid placement explicit per breakpoint; the 390px layout is a single column
cards must not be nested (card-in-card is CRITIQUE hard fail 3)
sections.content: Each tile is one capability with a concrete artefact (a real UI crop, a real output). No icon-above-title-above-lorem triples.
sections.motion: reveal per tile with a 40-80ms stagger; hover = one transform axis + one shadow step, never scale+rotate+blur.
a11y: tile headings are h3 under a section h2
hover states never resize the tile (layout shift)
contrast of any text on a tinted tile
hardFails: three equal columns of icon+title+lorem (hard fail 3)
avoidWhen: features are a list, not a matrix - use feature-alternating-detail

sections.name: Alternating image/text detail rows
build: max ONE zigzag family per page (Part 1b); alternate side only across rows, never twice in a row
each row is one claim + one artefact; the artefact is a real screenshot or a real component
the media column is `sticky` only when the section has >2 rows
sections.content: Rows map to the product's real mechanics (how it works), not to marketing headings.
sections.motion: row media reveals with the same single entrance grammar; no parallax on text (motion sickness).
a11y: media alt text
reading order matches visual order at 390px
no horizontal scroll at 390px
hardFails: two zigzag rows in a row
text moving faster than the viewport can render

sections.name: Comparison table (replaces the 3-card row)
build: the honest 'what it does not do' column is a differentiator, not a weakness
row height stable; tabular-nums; no zebra + border + shadow stacking
390px -> a stacked definition list, never a horizontally scrolled table
sections.content: Real feature names from the product; real values; empty cells say 'No' not a blank.
sections.motion: none - comparison tables should not animate (motion on a table delays reading).
a11y: <table> semantics with th scope
caption or aria-label
focus-visible on any interactive cell
hardFails: a table that is really three marketing cards
avoidWhen: the product has no meaningful comparison axis

sections.name: Terminal / code demo block

sources.note: real syntax highlighting, no hand-rolled token colours

build: real output only - a real command that really runs and its real result
the copy button is a real clipboard write with a copied/error state
never re-draw window chrome with divs (hard fail 12) - a real code block with a real highlighter is fine
sections.content: The actual CLI invocation, the actual output, the actual version string.
sections.motion: type-on reveal is allowed ONCE on the page, <=1.2s total, and reduced-motion collapses it to an instant fade.
a11y: copy button is keyboard reachable with a live-region confirmation
code contrast >=4.5:1
no focus trap
hardFails: type-on that never completes when JS is slow
avoidWhen: the product has no CLI/code surface

sections.name: Integrations grid / orbit
build: orbit is decoration: it must carry real names, never invented logos
reduced motion freezes the orbit; the names remain readable
grid fallback at 390px
sections.content: Real integration names the product actually supports.
sections.motion: slow constant rotation (never linear on text the user must read; rotate the ring, not the labels).
a11y: labels are real text, not images
pauses under reduced motion
no motion in the user's reading path

sections.name: Process / timeline
build: steps are real, numbered, and each has an artefact
no scroll-driven horizontal pinning on mobile
the connector line is a token, not a gradient
sections.content: Step = verb + artefact + outcome. No 'Step 1: Sign up' filler if the product has no signup.
sections.motion: reveal each step as it enters the viewport, same grammar as the rest of the page.
a11y: ordered list semantics <ol>
step numbers are text, not only a graphic
connectors are aria-hidden
hardFails: timeline used as decoration with no sequence

sections.name: Three-tier pricing with switch

sources.note: uses the animated toggle; keep the Radix Tabs semantics

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add tabs badge tooltip button

build: the toggle is an accessible Tabs/radio group, NOT a custom div switch (hard fail 9)
card height is fixed across billing periods - never animate container height (layout shift)
prices are real DOM text (tabular-nums); the discount badge states the real terms
the recommended tier is exactly one, and the reason is stated
sections.content: Real prices, real limits, real currency; 'Contact us' only when a real sales motion exists; footnote lists what is metered.
sections.motion: price digits swap with a 180ms cross-fade or NumberFlow; the thumb springs; no height animation.
a11y: aria-selected/aria-label on the billing switch
screen-reader announcement of the new price
the badge is not the only carrier of meaning (colour-blind safe)
avoidWhen: pricing is not public - use a contact/CTA section instead

sections.name: FAQ accordion

sources.note: animated height done correctly

build: real support questions, not invented objections
max 1 eyebrow per 3 sections - the FAQ usually needs none
answers are 2-4 sentences; long answers link to docs instead
single-open (collapsible) is the default; multi-open only when answers are scanned
sections.content: Questions pulled from a real support inbox/issue tracker; each answer states a fact or a limit.
sections.motion: height animation on the panel only, 240ms inOut; never `transition-all` (hard fail 10).
a11y: button carries aria-expanded + aria-controls
panel has role region + labelled heading
keyboard: Enter/Space, arrow keys optional

sections.name: Closing CTA band
build: ONE CTA intent across the whole page - the label here repeats the hero's primary label verbatim (Part 1b)
max one centred CTA band per page
no full-bleed h-screen band; use padding rhythm, not viewport height
sections.content: The strongest honest reason to act, plus the primary action. If the product is self-serve, add the real command or a real trial link.
sections.motion: the band is the one place a second kinetic moment is allowed - or none at all.
a11y: the input (if any) has a real label
errors are inline and announced
no captcha-only gate on the primary path
hardFails: two CTAs with the same intent
avoidWhen: the page already ends on a conversion surface

sections.name: Footer with real navigation
build: a different footer archetype per page of the same site (Part 1b)
real links only; a dead link is worse than no link
status/version/changelog entries when they exist; legal identifiers when they exist
sections.content: Columns reflect the real IA; include the honest status line only if a real status page exists.
sections.motion: none - the footer does not perform.
a11y: <footer> landmark
nav labels are real
external links state that (no silent new tabs)

sections.name: Chart panel bound to tokens

sources.note: verify licence before shipping
shadcn chart wraps Recharts and binds colours to --chart-* tokens

build: chart colours come from --chart-* tokens; no raw hex in the chart config
empty (no data), partial (some series missing), error (query failed) all designed
axis labels are real units; no truncated axis without a marker
hover tooltip is keyboard-reachable or an equivalent table view exists
sections.content: Real series names and units; a stated time range; the honest 'data as of' line.
sections.motion: animate the series reveal once (<=700ms), never on every resize; no infinite shimmer on a loaded chart.
a11y: chart has a text summary or an accessible table alternative
colour is never the only series differentiator (pattern/label too)
contrast of gridlines >=3:1
hardFails: rainbow palette with no semantic meaning

sections.name: Forms with real validation

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add form input label select textarea checkbox radio-group switch button sonner

build: React Hook Form + zod via the shadcn Form primitive; never a hand-rolled validation loop
labels are ALWAYS visible (placeholder-as-label is banned)
errors are inline, attached to the field, announced, and say what to do
submit stays ENABLED and shows a real pending/error state (Vercel guidelines)
never block paste; never disable right-click; autocomplete/inputmode set correctly
sections.content: Real field names and real help text; microcopy states what happens next; destructive actions confirm or offer undo.
sections.motion: no layout shift on error (reserve the message slot); inline validation after blur, not on first keystroke.
a11y: every control has a programmatic label
aria-invalid + aria-describedby wired on error
focus moves to the first invalid field on submit
error text contrast >=4.5:1

sections.name: Data table with real states

sources.note: largest practical app-component set
stacked fallback when the data is really a list

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add table dropdown-menu checkbox pagination badge skeleton sonner

build: skeleton geometry EQUALS the final row geometry (no jump)
empty state has a real next action, not just an illustration
tabular-nums for every numeric column; right-align numerals, left-align text
column widths stable across states; long strings truncate with a tooltip
row actions are a DropdownMenu primitive, never a hand-built popover
390px: the table scrolls inside a contained container, the page never scrolls sideways
sections.content: Real column names; real row values; a real 'no rows' reason; export/CSV only if it really works.
sections.motion: no row-entrance animation on load; row reorder uses @formkit/auto-animate (one line) if reorder exists.
a11y: <table> semantics or role=grid with correct headers
keyboard-navigable row actions
pagination announces the new range
focus-visible on every interactive cell
hardFails: spinner instead of a skeleton matching the table
horizontal page scroll instead of a contained table

sections.name: State set (loading / empty / error / partial)

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add skeleton alert button sonner

build: skeletons match the geometry of what replaces them (no jump)
empty states carry a next action and, when useful, teach
error states name the failure and the recovery, and keep the user's input
offline and permission-denied designed where the product can hit them
sections.content: Copy tells the user what to do next; no 'Something went wrong' alone; no fake retry that cannot succeed.
sections.motion: skeleton shimmer is one grammar at <=1.4s; reduced motion -> static neutral block.
a11y: live region announces loading->loaded and errors
focus is not stolen by a loading swap
error alert is role=alert or aria-live=assertive

sections.name: Onboarding stepper

sources.note: check the site for the exact variant

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add progress button form

build: step count visible; back is always possible; state persists across reload
each step has one job and a real validation gate
never block the whole flow on an optional field
sections.content: Steps use the product's real setup concepts, not generic 'Tell us about you' filler.
sections.motion: step transition is a 240ms directional slide or cross-fade, one grammar, reduced-motion -> fade.
a11y: progress announces the current step
step title is a heading; only one h1 on the screen
focus moves to the new step heading on change
hardFails: progress indicator as the only affordance

sections.name: Mobile screen (React Native)

sources.command: npx @react-native-reusables/cli@latest add button card input text avatar
sources.note: shadcn's RN port; same token names where possible. Verify the item names against the registry before installing.
UI-thread animation; never JS-thread for gestures
long lists

build: Reanimated only for motion; animate transform/opacity
native stack + native tabs; no JS tab bars
safe areas honoured (top and bottom); 44pt minimum touch targets
expo-image for images with a real placeholder
sections.content: Real screen titles and real empty states; platform-idiomatic verbs.
sections.motion: shared-element / layout transitions via Reanimated layout animations; no web motion libraries in the RN bundle.
a11y: accessibilityLabel on icon-only controls
accessibilityRole on interactive elements
focus order follows visual order
dynamic type supported (no fixed font sizes that clip)
hardFails: web motion library in an RN bundle
fixed heights that clip at large dynamic type

sections.name: Docs shell (nav + on-this-page)

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add sidebar scroll-area breadcrumb separator

build: three-column at >=1280px; collapse to nav+content at 768; content-only at 390
on-this-page is generated from real headings, with the active heading marked by IntersectionObserver
code blocks use a real highlighter with a copy button
sections.content: Real API names and real examples; 'Coming soon' is banned - remove the page instead.
sections.motion: none on the article body; on-this-page highlight is a 120ms transition.
a11y: skip-to-content
heading hierarchy with no level skipped
code block scrolls, page does not
anchor links are focusable and land with offset
hardFails: anchor scroll hidden behind a sticky header

sections.name: App shell with collapsible sidebar

sources.note: animated on the Radix primitive
alternative when the app is not on the Radix sidebar primitive

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add sidebar breadcrumb separator sheet

build: collapsed state persists (localStorage) and is a real width token, not a transform hack
below 768px the sidebar becomes a Sheet; never a squeezed rail
NO entrance animation on the shell - a dashboard fading in delays data (EXAMPLES.md Example B)
the content region is a CSS Grid area, not flex percentage math
one sidebar archetype per site: a second surface gets a different shell
an app shell must never be used as a marketing navbar - nav-floating/nav-classic-sticky own that role
sections.content: Real route labels; the breadcrumb reflects the actual hierarchy; the account menu shows the real identity shape (no invented avatars).
sections.motion: sidebar collapse is the only 200ms inOut transition in the shell; nothing else animates.
a11y: <nav> landmark with aria-label
collapse toggle carries aria-expanded
skip link targets the content region
focus returns to the toggle after collapsing
hardFails: sidebar that overlays content on desktop

sections.name: Dashboard overview (KPIs + primary chart)

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add card toggle-group select skeleton

build: group KPIs by DECISION, not by data type (Example B); 3-5 KPIs maximum
each KPI carries a comparison (vs. previous period) and its own range control
borders are EARNED: remove 60% of card borders, use spacing + a section header instead
one primary chart per view; secondary charts live behind a tab
NO entrance animation - dashboards must not fade in (delays data)
sections.content: Real metric names, real ranges, real comparison periods, and a visible 'as of' timestamp.
sections.motion: none on first paint; range-change re-fetch shows the skeleton that matches the chart geometry.
a11y: KPI values are text with tabular-nums, not images
the range control is a real radio/tab group
chart has a table alternative or a summary

sections.name: Authentication screens

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add form input label button separator alert

build: one column, one job, one primary action; no marketing on an auth screen
OTP fields are a real input group with paste support across boxes
error states never reveal whether an account exists (security copy)
the page renders without JS for the form shell
sections.content: Real auth method names the product supports; honest copy about what happens after submit.
sections.motion: none beyond focus and a 120ms button pending state; never animate the form on mount.
a11y: autocomplete attributes (username / one-time-code / current-password)
error summary is announced
password managers can paste
focus lands on the first field
hardFails: auth screen with a hero and three cards
inventing SSO providers that do not exist
blocking paste in an OTP field

sections.name: Blog index / changelog

sources.note: verify the item name against the registry

sources.command: npx shadcn@latest add card badge separator pagination

build: real dates and real reading time, or neither
changelog entries are versioned and dated; no 'coming soon'
an index with no posts shows an empty state, not a fake grid
cover images have explicit dimensions and real alt text
sections.content: Real titles and real excerpts from the actual content; the feed is RSS-linked when it exists.
sections.motion: none on the list; an optional 120ms hover elevation change on cards.
a11y: <time datetime> on dates
list semantics <ul>/<li> or <article>
pagination is keyboard operable and announces the page
hardFails: invented posts to fill an index

sections.name: Error and 404 surfaces
build: the 404 offers the real paths back: search, home, the most-visited links
a 500 keeps the user's work and offers a retry that can succeed
the surface inherits the site's type and colour system - it is not a bare default page
sections.content: Copy names what happened and gives the next action; no joke copy that hides the path forward.
sections.motion: none, or a single gentle reveal; an error page is not a showcase.
a11y: the page keeps the site's landmarks and skip link
the status is real (404/500), not a soft 200
search input is labelled
hardFails: a 404 that is a dead end

sections.name: Single-component delivery

sources.note: swap for the actual primitive needed

build: scope is ONE component: scout still runs (>=3 references), the contract is local (durations, easing, accent)
the component ships ALL 8 states: default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading, error, success
built on the accessible primitive (Radix/Base UI), never a div with onClick
sections.content: Real labels for the component's real use; no lorem in a demo.
sections.motion: local motion contract: micro 120ms, ui 200ms, one spring for interactive thumbs; reduced-motion honoured.
a11y: keyboard path complete (arrow keys where the primitive expects them)
focus ring visible in both themes
reduced motion verified on the component itself
hardFails: a component demo with three fake variants
animating container height and shifting the page
